page_title: PAU 0-3 HOF | St. Pauli v Hoffenheim 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Oliver Baumann comes off his line to intercept the corner from Danel Sinani (St. Pauli).
90+6' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. St. Pauli earn a corner.
90+6' Hoffenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' The goal by St. Pauli won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' The St. Pauli players halt their celebrations as referee Sven Jablonski makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

88' What a beautiful moment! Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the left post. Oliver Baumann just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:3.
87' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
87' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul. St. Pauli have a free kick.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) comes onto the pitch for Tim Lemperle.
86' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Albian Hajdari is replaced by Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joel Fujita trots off the pitch and is replaced by Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
82' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
79' 0 - 3 Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) latched on to a sweet pass and coolly slotted the ball inside the right post.
76' Substitution. Andrej Kramaric makes way for Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim).
76' Bazoumana Toure will be replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
75' Substitution. Karol Mets (St. Pauli) in, Lars Ritzka out.
75' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a change. Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) replaces Adam Dzwigala.
73' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fisnik Asllani leaves the pitch and Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) comes on.
69' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
67' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli).
67' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle and signals a foul after Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Hoffenheim.
67' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
63' Here is a change. Martijn Kaars is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli).
63' Here comes a substitution. Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) is brought on as a substitute for Mathias Pereira Lage.

59' 0 - 2 Vladimir Coufal sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:2.
59' Hoffenheim seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
54' Sven Jablonski sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
54' Wait! Referee Sven Jablonski has indicated he is going to review the Hoffenheim goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

54' 0 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
53' A corner kick by Hoffenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli).
53' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
52' Hoffenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
52' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball is out of play. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.

52' This was a piece of cake for Nikola Vasilj. Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.
48' Hoffenheim take a short corner kick.
48' A pass from Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) is intercepted by Nikola Vasilj and the move breaks down. The referee blows his whistle, Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
47' Great teamplay by Hoffenheim as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) receives a yellow card.

44' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Sven Jablonski stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. St. Pauli have a free kick.
43' A yellow-coloured card is received by Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim).
43' Sven Jablonski blows for a foul after Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. St. Pauli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
42' St. Pauli fail to score from a corner as Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) leaps to collect the ball.
41' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
37' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
37' A cross from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Hoffenheim win a corner.
35' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

35' Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to St. Pauli.
34' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) is flagged for offside.

33' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Hoffenheim, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

30' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
28' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Joel Fujita (St. Pauli). Sven Jablonski saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Hoffenheim have a free kick.
26' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) takes the corner which is cleared.

25' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball goes out of play. St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick.
23' Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
18' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
17' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Nikola Vasilj comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
15' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. It will be a corner kick for St. Pauli.
13' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. St. Pauli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
9' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the left post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
8' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
7' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Hoffenheim, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
5' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) sends a long ball in, but Nikola Vasilj comfortably gathers the ball.
5' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) trips an opposition player and Sven Jablonski signals a foul. That's a free kick to Hoffenheim.
2' Hoffenheim enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and St. Pauli will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Sven Jablonski.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
